target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, one vCPU, VirtIO input and VirtIO sound WAV backend
command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device -audiodev wav,id=sound0,path=build/flapbat-sound-cleanup.wav -device virtio-sound-pci,audiodev=sound0' python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-flapbat
evidence: The game drew its canvas, animated, responded to Space, exited through Escape and returned to a graphical terminal where 40+2 returned 42; zstatus reported failed=0.
The QEMU WAV capture contained 186984 nonzero stereo samples at 44100 Hz and several distinct pitches while the game ran. The experimental audio timer was not explicitly enabled.
After game exit, the guest reported flapbat_audio_hz=0 and song_alive=0. The probe now requires both values.
limits: Captured samples do not verify audible host output, real-time continuity, or exact melody and timing.
The catch-a-bug effect, full gameplay, live UTM and physical Pi audio were not verified.
